call.label: Alarm centre: police, fire and ambulance

call.label: Police, not an emergency
call.note: Staffed 07:00 to 23:00, then the police control centre. From abroad, +45 114.

call.label: Out-of-hours doctor, Region Syddanmark

call.label: Out-of-hours doctor, Region Midtjylland

call.note: Call before going in. Opening times differ by town.
